description: Set the human-readable name of a video / image / shape / text layer — the label shown in the Inspector, and the basis for the layer's auto-derived <morpha-video> embed attribute (so renaming a layer to "caption" makes the embed attribute `caption`). Pass an empty string to clear the name. For groups use rename_group.
